🛑 Requirement: Enforce keyring isolation for the offline fixtures.

Putting a security shim on PATH does not isolate macOS keyring access: docs/macos-keyring.md documents that the backend invokes /usr/bin/security directly. Bound credential lookups reach TokenForUser, which probes the native keyring before the fixture's plaintext token, and this environment never enables or verifies the new debug isolation capability. Consequently the documented offline journeys still access the operator's keyring, contrary to docs/testing.md:62-66. Run these subprocesses under enforced containment, including the stable binary in the downgrade test, rather than relying on PATH shims.

🛑 Requirement: Keep the ordinary full acceptance run usable without ghdebug

An unfiltered acceptance run with a user-capable token includes this lifecycle: script selection filters on token capability, not build tags. Consequently, the documented invocation with only -tags=acceptance now always fails here, even though the other scripts do not require ghdebug. Skip or filter out this lifecycle when isolation support is unavailable, while still preventing its login/logout commands from running.

body:
🛑 Requirement: Preserve the configured API gateway when isolating the lifecycle

When GH_ACCEPTANCE_API_HOST is set, sharedSetup writes api_host into the original hosts.yml. Switching to this empty configuration discards that setting: the initial user lookup uses the gateway, but token validation during login and subsequent API calls use the logical host's default endpoint. This fails in gateway-only environments and no longer exercises the requested routing. Carry the host's api_host setting into the isolated configuration before login, without copying unrelated accounts.

🛑 Requirement: Test the real keyring-isolation capability output.

The existing version tests call the lower-level format helper, so they never exercise this new branch. The runner tests also use a fake gh that prints the capability marker itself; they cannot detect the real binary omitting or misreporting it. Add direct Format coverage showing that the marker appears only when keyring isolation is enabled in a ghdebug build and stays absent otherwise, since both evaluation runners rely on this output before account setup.
